gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tajawal: Tajawal keeps its plain sans letters light and open, with a hooked c and barely any swing in the stroke. Cherry Swash is the loud one here, flat-lined and wide.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tasa-explorer: A horseshoe-shaped c, with diagonals as heavy as the verticals, gives Cherry Swash its stamp. And TASA Explorer follows in a plain sans whose curves end like lifted brush strokes, so use the heading big.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tasa-orbiter: TASA Orbiter reads as a plain sans with every small counter left unclogged and easy to see into. Over many paragraphs it stays crisp, while Cherry Swash handles the loud opening in vinyl-cut single-width lines.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-teachers: Cherry Swash opens with its wide, horseshoe-shaped c. Teachers follows like thin steel rod bent into sans letters, strokes tapering out before they touch, so a long page feels light and modern.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-telex: Every curve in Cherry Swash holds a flat, unswelling line, with a c opened wide like a horseshoe. Telex is the opposite in temperament, a sans with loose, curvy letters that does the quiet work of the text.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tenor-sans: Chunky, flat, unmistakable. Cherry Swash reads like following a single thread, while Tenor Sans, a plain sans with stems a little heavier than its hairlines, gives text some light variation, so give the heading extra size.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tirra: Tirra reads in round forms that look like open parentheses, a sans-serif that never feels crowded. Cherry Swash has no calligraphic swing at all.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-titillium-web: Cherry Swash draws a horseshoe-shaped c and keeps its line width through every turn, which gives it presence. Titillium Web, a sans with stroke ends set far apart, makes a long stretch of text feel approachable and modern.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-tomorrow: Tomorrow reads with bowls that open like a cupped palm of clay, tidy and clean in a sans-serif way. Cherry Swash brings a quiet, level beat, with no accents of weight.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-trispace: Trispace sets sparse, widely spaced letters whose curves open outward instead of curling in, a sans-serif with room to spare. Cherry Swash, bent like neat pipe cleaner, sits above it.
